exposure: type of placental anomaly (placenta previa vs. placenta accreta spectrum disorders)
cohort: Sixty pregnant women diagnosed with placental anomalies (placenta previa or placenta accreta spectrum disorders) undergoing cesarean deliveries at Gulbarga Institute of Medical Sciences, Kalaburagi.
finding: Patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders experience significantly higher intraoperative and postoperative risks, including longer surgeries, greater estimated blood loss, more blood transfusions, and extended durations of mechanical ventilation and ICU stays, compared to those with placenta previa.
followup_time: up to a few days (based on ICU stay duration)
